references.view: Official preview artwork: tail, curved silver frames and iridescence; wing tips cropped
Game image: frontal armor and grounded hooves; near wing foreshortened
Guide duplicates the frontal game image

model_lookup.result: Exact English name and site-specific 3D searches did not yield a usable model. Rear geometry and relative wing depth remain unverified.

anchor_method: midpoint of opaque pixels in bottom 2 percent band
visual_review: Directly compared PNG and 110px rectangular profile in checkerboard and Nod-Krai placement. Four hooves, wing-frame gaps and pale tail remain readable. Fine iridescent bands and face detail merge on the lightweight profile.
provisional_details: Wing tips and relative wing depth were interpreted from the partially cropped official illustration and the foreshortened ground reference. Nod-Krai background is a local fixture.
measurement_scope: Local rectangle counts at a fixed display scale. Native frame time remains unmeasured.
